About Organization

The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) is a constitutional body in India that is responsible for conducting various exams and recruitments for government jobs.

The UPSC is committed to providing opportunities for Indian citizens to work in the public sector and contribute to the country's development.

About the Programme

The UPSC Principal and Vice Principal Recruitment 2026 is an opportunity for Indian citizens to work as Principals and Vice Principals in various educational institutions.

The programme aims to provide qualified and experienced candidates with the opportunity to work in the education sector and contribute to the development of the country.
